dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Make sure to pace yourself during a workout. Proper rest is often the key to overcoming your limits.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That said, "rest" doesn't have to mean sitting around and doing nothing. Come on, let's do some warm-ups to ease up those joints.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: The physical intensity is only going to increase from here on out. We must make sure we're prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: So the further we go, the more dangerous things get? I'm suddenly reminded of my quest to break the 200 push-up barrier...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: After I got to 190, I had to force out the last few reps with gritted teeth and pure determination. I know if I'd eased off the intensity even for moment, it would have been all over.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: But, I did it, I made it to 200. It was worth it just to see all the big meatheads at the fitness club looking at me with that dumbfounded look on their faces.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I've led my teammates to victory against the Abyss many times before. I must say, the experience here is quite reminiscent of those moments.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm enjoying the feeling of reliving past glories as we delve further into this domain.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It's not often that you get to experience something like this. So let's take every opportunity to challenge ourselves here!
